title: 23-Inch Three Tier Hotel-Style Towel Shelf With Drying Rack (Solid Brass) | Towel Shelves | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep folded towels organized and give damp linens a dedicated place to dry—without taking up counter space. This three tier hotel-style towel shelf combines storage and a drying rack for efficient bathroom organization.

  • More storage, less clutter: three-tier shelf design organizes folded towels vertically.
  • Daily-use drying space: integrated drying rack keeps bath linens accessible and off the vanity.
  • Built for lasting bathroom use: solid brass construction.
  • Easy to coordinate: designed to match the Towel Shelves towel shelves collection and complements transitional bathroom hardware.
  • Versatile placement: a smart choice for versatile bath accessories in guest baths and primary baths.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions: 23 in (L) x 10 in (H) x 9 in (W)
  • Shipping weight: 7 lbs
  • Installation: wall-mounted; mounting hardware included
  • Assembly: some assembly required
  • Assembled in the USA

Keep folded towels organized and give damp linens a dedicated place to dry—without taking up counter space in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. This three tier hotel-style towel shelf combines storage and a drying rack for efficient bathroom organization.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Daily-use drying space: integrated drying rack keeps bath linens accessible and off the vanity.
  • Built for lasting bathroom use: solid brass construction.
  • Easy to coordinate: designed to match the Towel Shelves towel shelves collection and complements transitional bathroom hardware.
  • Versatile placement: a smart choice for versatile bath accessories in guest baths and primary baths.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions: 23 in (L) x 10 in (H) x 9 in (W)
  • Shipping weight: 7 lbs
  • Installation: wall-mounted; mounting hardware included
  • Assembly: some assembly required
  • Assembled in the USA
